title: Tribal Movements Khonda Dora Uprisings
definition: The Khonda Dora uprisings were localized tribal revolts in the Visakhapatnam Agency area of Andhra Pradesh, primarily directed against the exploitation by 'Muttadars' (local landlords) and the restrictive forest policies of the British colonial administration.
importanceInUpsc: UPSC frequently tests regional tribal movements to assess the candidate's understanding of colonial land revenue systems, tribal agency, and the socio-economic impact of British administrative integration in the Madras Presidency.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Tribal Movements Khonda Dora Uprisings.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Understanding of the Permanent Settlement System
Knowledge of the Madras Agency Tracts Act, 1839
Basic geography of the Eastern Ghats
